reproduction_before_change.memory_routes_have_no_production_caller: services/memory/main.py:1052 (risk-review), :1072 (paper-endorse), :1090 (merge) are defined; `git grep` at base finds no non-test Python caller of any of the three, so a paper lesson never reached persona memory
reproduction_before_change.lesson_rule_proposals_route_has_no_calle: services/persona/lesson_rule_proposals.py:356 (POST) and :365 (GET) are the only references outside tests
reproduction_before_change.memory_candidates_never_consumed: integrations/openclaw/persona_ooda_runtime.py:43 declares the field; services/persona/persona_cycle_controller.py:311 only writes a telemetry ref string; integrations/openclaw/persona_memory_bridge.py:316 stage_openclaw_memory_writeback_candidate has no caller
further_breaks_found_while_wiring: paper-endorse took `episodes` from the HTTP caller (services/memory/main.py PaperEndorsePayload) - the gates could be satisfied by caller-supplied regimes
paper-endorse and the list route required operator governance roles, so the persona service principal could not call them
MemoryLessonReader forwarded the persona service's opaque credential to Memory, which verifies only JWTs, so every lesson-rule conversion by the service credential was lesson_source_unavailable
merged lesson memory was tagged only strategy_lesson/scope/persona, so the cycle case-file query (family:/underlying: tags and terms) could not retrieve it

changes.services/persona/lesson_cycle.py: new: LessonCycle.govern (risk persona turn -> Memory risk-review -> paper-endorse), .stage (memory_candidates -> registrar as proposed paper candidates), .convert (cited lessons -> POST lesson-rule-proposals with the persona service credential), lesson_summary
changes.services/persona/persona_cycle_controlle: consume_run calls stage + convert after the decisions and govern for ok runs of trading personas; lazily builds LessonCycle on the cycle's turn runner; cycle_health reports lessons; prompt states the memory_candidates / lesson_rule shape
changes.services/memory/main.py: paper-endorse reads supporting episodes from the trade journal owner (telemetry) and rejects an `episodes` field; persona-svc role may list/read candidates and paper-endorse; a risk persona `reject` review is the terminal paper decision; merged lesson carries family:/underlying: tags from the journal episodes
changes.services/persona/lesson_rule_proposals.p: MemoryLessonReader mints a tenant-bound persona-svc read identity for an opaque service credential

fail_closed: memory owner unconfigured/unreachable -> cycle record lesson_governance.status=unavailable with reason; nothing changes
trade journal unconfigured/unreachable -> paper-endorse 503 supporting_episodes_unavailable; candidate stays proposed
journal has no such episode or it belongs to another persona/tenant -> 422; never counted
risk persona turn failed or answered outside {approve,reject} -> risk_review_unavailable, no record, no state change
sensitive scope/wording, non-paper target, expired, foreign or under-supported candidates -> skipped without a risk turn; human endorsement path unchanged
lesson rule request without a spec, without a cited lesson, unendorsed lesson, or no persona service credential -> not_converted with the reason
memory_candidates without scope/proposed_change/confidence -> not_staged; staged ones are proposed paper candidates, never canonical memory

integration_test.real: persona owner app (pattern-review route, reflection pipeline, registrar, lesson-rule route, harness owner and converter), Memory app (candidate store, risk review, paper endorse, persona memory, retrieve), case-file composer, LessonCycle; all over real HTTP
integration_test.scripted: reflection provider and risk persona answer (the models); trade journal owner as a telemetry-shaped HTTP fixture
integration_test.path: two closed episodes -> pattern review -> registered candidate -> risk review -> merge -> case-file lessons group cites pmem-lesson-<id> -> harness_patch lesson rule recorded via the owner route

open_dependencies: Memory service needs PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_API_URL and PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_SERVICE_TOKEN in docker-compose.yml (memory block has neither) - outside this task's artifact list; without them paper-endorse fails closed with supporting_episodes_unavailable

Memory strict-mode role map must admit the case-file retrieve identity (PERSONA_MEMORY_SERVICE_TOKEN is issued with role persona_session only, which is not in memory _MEMORY_READ_ROLES) - not verified on hosted; belongs to the owner-ports wiring task
The persona process needs PERSONA_JWT_SECRET equal to the Memory JWT secret to mint the service identities (already required by the lesson registrar)
Hosted acceptance is a separate step; this is local evidence, not hosted-performance evidence
